# Alpha.4 fixture matrix

The machine-readable source is `fixtures/alpha4/fixture-matrix.json`.

| Scenario | Expected profile behavior |
|---|---|
| Routine private package change | Inline guidance; no focused structure reviewer |
| Public API and wire contract | Contract projection plus API and focused structure review |
| Goroutine cancellation and shutdown | State/lifecycle ownership plus correctness review |
| Channel ownership and backpressure | Channel protocol and failure review |
| Explicit execution-slicing task | Slice projection, touchpoint, candidate boundary, and evidence |
| Persistence migration | Structure, migration, evidence, and consumer checks |
| Module/downstream consumer | Standalone consumer touchpoint and module-release evidence |
| CGO/unsafe boundary | Native boundary projection and focused assurance |
| Valid foundation slice | Accepted only with named risk, own touchpoint, and enabled next slice |
| Invalid horizontal foundation | Blocking at consequential tier |
| Unsupported procedure-only subject | Bounded `UNSUPPORTED` result |
| Harmless private divergence | Within delegated freedom; no material finding |
| Fixed package owner divergence | `MATERIAL_DIVERGENCE` with exact fixed-decision reference |
| Missing fixed-decision evidence | `BLOCKED`, not assumed conforming |
| Legacy alpha.3 profile | `legacy-unprojected` under alpha.4 semantics |
| Required Go tool unavailable | `BLOCKED` when `--run-tools` explicitly requires it |

The fixtures establish resolver and projection behavior. They do not claim live correctness for every repository, Go toolchain, OMP release, platform, or operational environment.
